settings.intro:
This is the two of us thinking out loud. We're inquiry-trained classroom teachers (one of us a learning specialist) who packed up the van, took our daughter on the road, and started theINmag along the way. IN the field is where we write down what we keep learning about teaching, learning and creativity: in classrooms, in homeschool kitchens, and around the campfire.

No jargon, nothing you couldn't run on a Monday morning.
